name: SignMate - Sign Language Interpreter
summary: SignMate is an AI-powered sign language interpretation system that recognizes hand gestures using a deep learning model and converts them into readable text. The application aims to reduce communication barriers between individuals who use sign language and those who do not by providing real-time gesture recognition.
problem_statement: Communication between hearing-impaired individuals and people unfamiliar with sign language can be challenging. Existing solutions are often expensive, require specialized hardware, or support only a limited vocabulary. SignMate was developed as an affordable and accessible solution capable of recognizing common sign language gestures in real time.
objective: To build a lightweight AI-based application that recognizes sign language gestures using computer vision and deep learning, enabling faster and more effective communication.
my_role: I participated in designing the machine learning pipeline, preparing the training dataset, training the deep learning model using Teachable Machine, converting the model to TensorFlow Lite, integrating it into the application, and testing prediction accuracy.
features: Recognition of predefined sign language gestures
workflow: Capture an image using the camera.
Pass the image to the TensorFlow Lite model.
The model predicts the corresponding sign.
Display the recognized gesture as text to the user.
challenges: Improving model accuracy for similar hand gestures.
Reducing prediction latency for real-time recognition.
Handling variations in lighting and camera angles.
Optimizing the model for lightweight deployment.
solutions: Used Google's Teachable Machine for model training.
Converted the trained model to TensorFlow Lite for efficient inference.
Tested the model using multiple sample images under different conditions.
Optimized the application for faster predictions.
learning_outcomes: Learned the fundamentals of image classification.
Gained experience with TensorFlow Lite deployment.
Understood the complete machine learning workflow.
Improved knowledge of computer vision techniques.
Learned model optimization for real-time applications.
future_improvements: Support complete sentence formation instead of individual gestures.
Recognize a larger sign language vocabulary.
Deploy as an Android and iOS application.
Improve accuracy using a custom-trained deep learning model.
resume_description: Developed an AI-powered sign language interpretation system using Python, TensorFlow Lite, MobileNet, and computer vision techniques to recognize hand gestures and convert them into readable text.
